title: Phycocyanin Extraction from Synechocystis
author: Sebastian ST Triesch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sr2ed8e

steps.title: Collect Synechocystis Culture
steps.instruction: Collect 1 ml Synechocystis liquid culture and centrifuge to isolate the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the culture at 14,000 g for 5 min

steps.title: Prepare Glass Bead Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes for cell lysis.

substeps.instruction: Fill each tube with 400 ml glass beads (~0.5 mm)

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the collected pellet in PBS buffer and transfer to the bead tubes.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml PBS Buffer (pH = 7.4)
Transfer the solution into the prepared 1.5 ml tubes containing glass beads

steps.title: Lyse Cells via Vortexing
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples to extract phycocyanin until the supernatant is blue-green and clear.

substeps.instruction: Vortex each sample thoroughly for 1 min
Repeat the vortexing process five times

steps.title: Remove Cell Debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the vortexed sample to separate the supernatant from debris.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the sample for 5 min at 3,000 g at 4 °C
Transfer the supernatant into a fresh 2 ml Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Clarify Supernatant
steps.instruction: Perform a high-speed centrifugation to further clarify the extract.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the supernatant at 14,000 g for 20 min at 4 °C

steps.title: Measure Extinction
steps.instruction: Quantify the phycocyanin concentration using spectrophotometry.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the blue supernatant into a cuvette
